recognize_zh: EBV 潛伏膜蛋白（LMP1）免疫染色：在大量藍色、未染色的淋巴球與較大細胞之間，只有少數散在細胞的細胞質／細胞膜呈深棕色陽性，代表部分細胞帶有 EBV，支持 EBV 相關的 PTLD。
features: Immunohistochemical stain for EBV latent membrane protein 1 (LMP1) with hematoxylin counterstain
Scattered cells with strong brown cytoplasmic/membranous staining
Positive cells vary in size, including a larger elongated cell and small round cells
Majority of small lymphoid cells and larger vesicular cells are negative
Loose, partly edematous background in the upper field
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for EBV LMP1 shows scattered cells with strong cytoplasmic and membranous staining, including a larger elongated cell and several smaller round cells, among a predominantly negative population of small lymphoid cells and larger vesicular cells. Only a minority of cells are positive in this field. Findings indicate the presence of EBV-infected cells and support an EBV-associated post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder; EBER in situ hybridization is more sensitive for quantifying EBV-positive cells.

ddx.vs: EBV-negative PTLD typically occurs late after transplant and lacks LMP1/EBER-positive cells, whereas positive cells are present here.

ddx.dx: Scattered EBV-positive bystander B cells in reactive tissue
ddx.vs: Rare EBER-positive cells can be seen in reactive nodes of healthy carriers, so the diagnosis depends on architectural effacement and a significant positive population rather than any positivity.
LMP1 highlights large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells that are CD30+ and CD15+ in cHL-type PTLD, rather than variably sized plasmacytoid cells.
